meta.why: All imf.org hosts return HTTP 403 at the Akamai edge from this build environment (website, DataMapper API and data.imf.org), including via a real browser. Not a User-Agent issue and not evaded.
meta.unblock: Run this script from a network where imf.org is reachable, or place data/manual/imf_weo.json.
meta.site_behaviour: No IMF line is drawn. OECD EO and UN WPP still provide institutional forecasts.
meta.render_rule: Solid, attributed line when data exists. Never blended with the naive extrapolation.
